initial_claims.meaning: Engineer OPINION: for 600 mm product a roll diameter of 650-700 mm is more suitable. Recorded against a hypothetical FUTURE_STAND, not against the installed roll.
initial_claims.evidence_locator: engineer requirement note, relayed by owner 2026-09-21
initial_claims.note: CALCULATED 2026-09-21: going 518 -> 700 mm raises roll force 24%, torque 44%, power 44% and neck stress 24% at the same pass. A larger diameter does NOT make 600 mm easier - it shifts the mechanical limit. What it does buy is bite capacity: max draft rises 23.3 -> 31.5 mm, i.e. fewer passes. The instinct is right; the stated reason is not.

initial_claims.meaning: Engineer OPINION: an 800 mm barrel is more suitable for 600 mm product. Note this is SHORTER than the installed 1280 mm barrel.
initial_claims.evidence_locator: engineer requirement note, relayed by owner 2026-09-21
initial_claims.note: CALCULATED 2026-09-21: at 600 mm width, barrel deflection is 0.333 mm with the 1280 mm barrel and 0.100 mm with an 800 mm barrel - 3.3x better. The shortening IS the point: a 1280 mm barrel carrying a 600 mm strip has 340 mm of unloaded overhang each side. This is the strongest engineering judgement in the requirement. It implies a DEDICATED stand, not a modification.
